hypothesis: Numerically programmed persistent associative operator slots, NOT a 10548-program grammar enumeration, may acquire previously unnamed Boolean-conditioned causal routing functions from verified consequences, survive cold restore and transfer to unfamiliar primitive worlds with lower entire-workflow cost than the strongest independently coded symbolic table/control at comparable accuracy. No supplied mechanism or finite basis is claimed to be a spontaneously invented computational primitive.

source.kind: fresh standalone synthetic causal operator-transfer source (not WSP120 replay)
source.gates: Three independent public feature bits: parity(subject), parity(first-hop of path A), parity(first-hop of path B); target chooses one of two known two-hop candidate causal paths. The hidden 8-entry truth table is independently derived per family and shared across its fit/transfer worlds. Worlds are independent seeded primitive permutations; no fit/transfer world overlap; reject graph/source ambiguities under bounded preregistered deterministic rejection. Gate truth table hidden from learner, only externally requested endpoints revealed.
source.data_access: Only published graph, allowable inquiry pool, verified answers after inquiry. No held endpoint, hidden selector, target truth table or reserved source before scoring.

learners.DIRECT_NUMERIC: At most 16 signed int32 support/contradiction synaptic counts, indexed by an 8-way visible causal context and route; learned via explicit verified-error/consistency writes, no gradient optimizer, no full-program enumeration. Retain across fit and unfamiliar transfer worlds. Unknown or contradictory context must abstain.
learners.NUMERIC_RESET: Identical numeric writer and source budget; reset operator synapses at each new transfer world, eliminating carryover as causal ablation.
learners.SYMBOLIC_TABLE_STRONG: Independent exact symbolic memo/constraint table of all 8 contexts; shares identical fit/transfer evidence and allowed operators, optimized constant-time lookup and carryover, not deliberately slow enumeration. May tie or outperform. Full Python memory including rule table counted.
learners.SYMBOLIC_ENUM: Independent 256-table exhaustive symbolic hypothesis comparator, equally able to carry fit evidence; timing diagnostic, never the strongest-control substitute.
learners.TRAINED_MLP: Conventional fully trained supervised 3-bit-input categorical route predictor; same revealed fit/transfer observations; 3 independent pinned optimization seeds, training-only convergence and checkpoint selection, undertrained control invalidates scientific superiority claims. Fully train on CPU and check training accuracy/loss; exact architecture/deps finalized before first use.
learners.NO_UPDATE: Evidence-blind deterministic counterfactual with fixed initial responses; zero feedback-dependent writes.

negative_controls: Deliberately random/non-parity shared gate; no hardcoded XOR assumption
Unseen context with no supported relation must abstain
Flip hidden gate between fit and transfer, detect interference rather than claim retention
Swap the public graph while keeping subject IDs, reject identity-only memorization
Tamper count snapshot and reject via SHA256 plus recompute provenance
Strong symbolic table parity or win => no unique numerical advantage
Training convergence or cross-platform control disagreement => science INVALID
primary_metrics: held causal endpoint accuracy with abstentions incorrect on 24 transfer worlds
negative/abstention/confident-wrong by gate family and world
unique correct discovered truth-table entries after fit vs transfer cold restore
matched verified source actions and SHA256 receipts
64-bit or int32 numeric learned bytes vs actual independent symbolic bytes and optimizer parameters
full source+train+infer+restore wall time per platform; peak RSS and energy proxy
matched exact symbolic table and fully trained conventional control; cross-platform parity
interference under a prospective gate flip; cold retention on all transferred worlds
frozen_decision: Development signal only if >=80% transfer held accuracy after <=4 fresh transfer source calls, >=25 percentage points above numeric-reset, 95% paired-world bootstrap lower>0 and zero confident wrong, cold integrity on every world. Strong SCIENTIFIC_PASS requires independent first-use, >=5 percentage point absolute gain against BOTH optimized symbolic table and fully converged conventional control with CI lower>0 OR >=2x fully measured end-to-end speed/cost advantage at non-inferior held accuracy with paired 95% lower bound >0; no missing comparator; transferred context must be an independently unfamiliar graph. Scientific pass cannot be implied by engineering fixture.

engineering_fixtures.full_regression: final exact SHA Ubuntu and Windows, inherited WSP117-120, root 54+ and G29 source atlas

known_limitations: The general Boolean selector table and path primitives are supplied by the architecture; learning its entries does not prove autonomous invention of arbitrary operators, language, intelligence or AGI. A fast numeric lookup tied to optimized symbolic lookup is not scientific superiority. Source generator, baseline convergence and statistical implementation must be frozen and independently qualified before original-science activation.
